notes.title: The damn AI freeze bug finally killed
notes.content:
Hey folks I read your complains about these specific bug and I foudn and killed it.
Sometimes AI froze without crashing the game. I got no error report, but you had to manually kill the game.
This bug should now be solved.

Also some small bugs:
[list]
[*]Bishop lost his idle animation
[*]The board was turned 90 degree so white queen was on black in chess mode.
[/list]

tags.bug: This bug should now be solved.
- The board was turned 90 degree so white queen was on black in chess mode.

notes.title: Hotfixes
notes.content:
Nothing big to see here. Just made some minor bugfixes.
[list]
[*]Language resetted sometimes to english on restart
[*]1 special formation couldn't be unlocked
[*]Some dialogs had a bad placement
[*]One puzzle freezed sometimes
[/list]

tags.bug: [*]Language resetted sometimes to english on restart

notes.title: Finally Localized
notes.content:
Hey fellas,
you can finally play this game in multiple languages:
[list]
[*]English
[*]German
[*]Spanish
[*]Dutch
[*]Polish
[*]Italian
[*]French
[/list]

If one of those is your mothertongue. Feel free to report errors and I'm more than happy to correct them.

tags.feature: you can finally play this game in multiple languages:

notes.title: New Update
notes.content:
The game is out a week. Because there are now plenty new players I got a lot some bug reports and improvement ideas.
While some of them will take longer I hotfixed a few already.
If you have further ideas to improve the game or found some bug, just reach out to me on social media. Best place to get in contact is twitter ;)

Improvements:
[list]
[*]The tutorial is now easier to find, so new player know what to do right away instead of just clicking around
[*]If you retry a puzzle you have a better transition instead of staring at an empty board
[/list]

Bugfixes:
[list]
[*]Some buttons were partly blocked by objects in the background. Now everything is easily clickable
[*]Fixed some typos
[*]On the demo end screen 2 songs were playing simultaniously
[*]Some special levels hasn't been unlocked although the requirements were fullfilled
[/list]
